info.name: Tailwind CSS, Responsive Breakpoints
info.description: Displays a live, semi-transparent overlay in the bottom-left corner of any webpage showing the current Tailwind CSS responsive breakpoint and screen orientation. As you resize your browser window, the indicator updates in real time across all six breakpoints — Base/Default (<640px), SM (≥640px), MD (≥768px), LG (≥1024px), XL (≥1280px), and 2XL (≥1536px) — plus a second line that toggles between Portrait and Landscape. A handy visual aid for frontend developers building or debugging responsive layouts with Tailwind CSS.
